0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, 2-0 at home, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) enter this 4th game of the season on a three-game winning streak, while the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, 0.5 games back of 1st in the Northwest and 4th in the West) are also riding a two-game streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost the season series 1-2, including a 132-116 defeat in Portland on January 17, 2026. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, while Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Scoot Henderson (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
